answer: R3 is not a temperature, uptime or catalyst-lot problem. External humidity rose from ~50-55% (weeks 1-13) to ~70-87% from week 14 on, and all reactors lost yield (~27-28 to ~23-24 g/g-cat). R3 is about twice as humidity-sensitive: slope -0.166 g/g-cat per %RH (R2 0.35) vs -0.076 to -0.09 for R1/R2/R4 (R2 0.15-0.22), so R3 fell to ~20-21.5 (weeks 20-26) instead of ~23-24. Likely cause: R3 is more exposed to humidity (moisture ingress/feed gas or seal issue); check R3 dryer/purge/seals. Lots FC-2606..2608 are low in all reactors but R3 is 2-4 lower in each.
